gyms.name: Bali MMA
gyms.notes: Bali's most established fight gym (est. 2014). Ring, MMA cage, AC grappling room, ice bath, sauna. Classes all day, all levels. Thai trainers on staff. ⭐ Top pick for a 30-day trip. Prices verified from balimma.com (Jul 2026 pricelist); 20% promo seen (~2.32M/mo).

gyms.name: Soma Fight Club
gyms.notes: Premium boutique fight gym — Muay Thai, boxing, BJJ, wrestling. Higher price, high-quality trainers. Open-gym-only monthly is 2M IDR. Prices verified from somafightclub.com (Aug 2026).

gyms.name: Body Factory Bali
gyms.notes: Luxury wellness gym, not a dedicated Muay Thai gym — great for recovery days (pool, ice bath, sauna). Silver 4-week plan 2.49M IDR +15% tax/service. Sister brand bodyfactorystays.com offers accommodation. Verify MT classes before committing.

gyms.name: Sinergy MMA
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices unverified (community reports, ~1.2–1.5M/mo). Budget-friendly local/expat gym, Muay Thai + MMA. Often recommended in expat groups. DM on Instagram to confirm.

gyms.name: Uluwatu MMA
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices unverified (~1.5–2M/mo). The main dedicated fight gym on the Bukit — best pick if you're staying Uluwatu/Bingin/Padang Padang. Muay Thai, boxing, BJJ. Confirm it's open via Instagram.

gyms.name: Bali Fight Academy
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices unverified (~1.5–2M/mo). Mixed community reviews — decent for beginners, scheduling reported inconsistent. Verify current status before committing a month.

gyms.name: Baik Bali Muay Thai
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices unverified (~1.5–2M/mo). Small friendly community gym, Thai trainers reported, authentic MT at budget prices.

gyms.name: Warrior's Path Bali
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices unverified (~2–3M/mo retreat packages). Holistic jungle retreat: Muay Thai + yoga + meditation. Great for wellness vibe, not a high-volume fight camp.

gyms.name: Legacy Gym Bali
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices unverified (~2–2.5M/mo). Solid mid-tier gym in Pererenan: Muay Thai, boxing, S&C. Positive reviews from long-term expat trainees.

gyms.name: Studio X
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices unverified (~1.5–2.5M/mo). Boutique fitness studio with boxing/kickboxing cardio classes — may not offer traditional MT pad work. Verify before booking.

gyms.name: Atlas Muay Thai (Bali)
gyms.notes: ❓ Could not confirm this gym exists — atlasmuaythai.com is an Australian gym. May be Instagram-only or misidentified. Verify independently.

gyms.name: Canggu Muay Thai (villa/mobile PT)
gyms.notes: Not a gym — trainer comes to your villa with pads and gear. Contact for weekly/monthly package rates. Great 1-on-1 supplement to gym training.

gyms.name: Bali Muay Thai (villa/mobile PT)
gyms.notes: Not a gym — island-wide mobile trainer service (Canggu, Seminyak, Ubud, Uluwatu, Sanur…). Best option if you're staying somewhere without a nearby gym. Contact for rates.
